description: A small feature in a Rust CLI: a --json flag printing the same data, no new dependencies, with tests.

steps.prompt: Add a --json flag to the stock CLI that prints the same items as a JSON array of {name, count} objects. Keep the table as the default, add no dependencies, and add a test.

checks.name: tests pass
checks.run: cargo test --offline -q 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q 'test result: ok'

checks.name: --json prints the items
checks.run: cargo run --offline -q -- --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert {x["name"]: x["count"] for x in d} == {"pallets": 12, "crates": 40, "drums": 3}'
